name: ICW 201- Upper River Rd
address: 201 Upper River Rd, Gold Hill, OR 97525

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial industrial facility with multiple buildings, including a prominent multi-section structure with a light-colored roof|The site features open dirt and gravel areas, paved driveways, and various equipment and materials stored throughout|The facility is located directly adjacent to the Rogue River, with rocky riverbanks visible along one side|The property is largely free of vegetation with the exception of a few trees scattered about

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main cluster of buildings with adjacent driveways and storage areas containing vehicles and equipment|Open dirt and gravel yards extend around the structures|The Rogue River is visible in the background along one edge of the property.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the main buildings with surrounding open dirt areas and equipment storage|Driveways and dirt roads connect different parts of the site|Vegetation and trees are present along portions of the perimeter, with the Rogue River visible nearby.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows additional open dirt and gravel areas with equipment and materials stored on site|The main building complex is visible, along with driveways providing circulation|The Rogue River runs along the edge of the property, with rocky banks and some vegetation.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the main buildings and extensive open dirt/gravel areas used for storage and operations|Driveways loop through the site, and the Rogue River is visible along the boundary with rocky shoreline and vegetation.

considerations: Vehicle access is available via paved and dirt driveways that connect the main buildings and storage areas. The large open dirt and gravel yards provide good space for emergency vehicle staging and movement. The facility is located directly adjacent to the Rogue River, which may serve as a water source but also requires consideration as a potential hazard. The site includes various equipment and materials stored in open areas.
clarifications: Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route that reaches all buildings and storage areas? Are there multiple points of entry into the main buildings? What is the primary use and contents of each of the buildings on the property? Is vehicle or personnel access available along the Rogue River frontage? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to specific storage or operational zones?
